composition_summary: Offline full-v3 export only. Host allocated unapproved draft PythonCode ca75d647-4f0e-5a35-abe7-cee7353e03c2 (result = host.post_reply(answer='Available')) and unapproved ToolSkill 9fd5b0e0-2d93-5f5d-bb57-63d5c93061f7 (binds existing host.post_reply(answer:string)). No execution, submission, Q1/Q2 or activation. The subworkflow posts exactly the fixed word 'Available' as a user reply via the bound Tool. One class21 recipe-transfer-05 with trigger=null, steps=[], dependency_registry=null, one desc_idx=0 using the persisted knowledge/stepnumber/type=component/include schema, two ordered component steps (rust ToolSkill 9fd5b0e0-2d93-5f5d-bb57-63d5c93061f7 then orchestrator PythonCode ca75d647-4f0e-5a35-abe7-cee7353e03c2), each step including exactly one UUID, tool_bindings=[] and dependencies=null. One variant with step_link=0:1-0:E, variable_patterns=[] and ten distinct reply intents. No runtime/approval claims; unapproved dependencies, Q1 and human Q2 required; current sink cannot preserve full v3 fields.
